instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Ana Ruiz. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Ana Ruiz. Do not return images or details of anyone.

Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov week 1.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. List any page or line that could not be read.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-02 00:00 to 2026-11-09 12:00 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Ana Ruiz and limit 500. Return every event with its event id, local time, camera and the identity name exactly as recorded, and say whether the list was cut at the limit. Read only. Do not return events of any other person. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline in time zone America/New_York for the cameras Front Door on these dates only: 2026-11-04, 2026-11-06, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type all and limit 500. For each event return only its local time, its camera and whether the person was recognised as a known identity (yes or no). Do not return names, faces, plates, snapshots or other details. Say whether any list was cut at the limit, and report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

said:
**Fair Hours: Ana Ruiz, 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08 (America/New_York)**
Bill: Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov week 1.pdf. Cameras: Front Door. Tolerance: 10 min (default), no agreed terms.

| Date | Billed | Seen at entry cameras | Difference | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mon 2026-11-02 | 09:00-12:00 (3 h 00 min) | 09:04-11:58 (2 h 54 min) | 6 min | Confirmed | 3 events |
| Wed 2026-11-04 | 09:00-13:00 (4 h 00 min) | 09:10-11:25 (2 h 15 min) | billed 1 h 45 min more than seen | Billed more than seen | 2 events |
| Thu 2026-11-05 | 14:00-17:00 (3 h 00 min) | 13:55-17:40 (3 h 45 min) | seen 45 min longer than billed | Seen more than billed | 4 events |
| Fri 2026-11-06 | 09:00-12:00 (3 h 00 min) | 09:02 only | none | Inconclusive: arrival or departure not recorded | 1 event |

No other dates in the period had Ana Ruiz sightings.

**Totals**
- Billed: 13 h 00 min over 4 visits.
- Confirmed: 3 h 00 min over 1 visit.
- Billed more than seen: 1 h 45 min over 1 visit.
- Seen more than billed: 0 h 45 min over 1 visit.
- Not seen while the cameras recognised other people: 0 h 00 min over 0 visits.
- Inconclusive: 3 h 00 min over 1 visit (arrival or departure not recorded).
- At the printed rates ($25/h): billed more than seen $43.75, and seen more than billed $18.75, side by side and not netted.

The bill's own arithmetic checks out: each line is hours x rate, and the lines add up to the printed total of $325.

**What this means**
One visit matched, and the differences run in both directions: on Wed 11-04 the bill is longer than the cameras saw, and on Thu 11-05 Ana was seen 45 minutes longer than billed. On Fri 11-06 only one sighting was recorded, so that visit cannot be judged. On 11-04, other people were recognised at the door during the billed time and no unrecognised passage was near her arrival or departure, but camera times show passages through the entry, not the work done between them. I'd suggest going through the differences with Ana, starting with Thursday's, which is in her favour.

I can load snapshots for Nov 4, 5 and 6 for you to review on the NAS. Would you like that, and would you like me to save this report to a folder on the NAS?
